audit_rule: A surviving physical prediction must be an empirical observable with a fixed operator, fixed measure, demonstrably prospective blind status, and derivation from the surviving unified parent action.

claims.claim: K=RP3 x S1 selected in the minimal carrier class
claims.reason: The uniqueness statement follows only after imposing the target conditions Vol(RP3)=pi^2 and phase step pi. It is valid inside that restricted class, but it does not independently show that nature chooses the carrier.

claims.claim: RP3 scalar and coexact spectra and scalar determinant
claims.reason: The external reproduction validates the implementation of known lens-space spectral mathematics. It is not an empirical prediction of S2T.
The combination is reproducible from declared volumes and holonomy, but no independent action maps it to a measured observable. Alpha inverse is a train input.
The branch coefficient is standard, but its assembly into S_vac is not derived from the full Maxwell-ghost determinant.

claims.claim: exact S_vac reproduction of alpha inverse
claims.reason: Alpha inverse is explicitly in the training set and the exact pi^-4 closure failed the same-scheme determinant audit.
The low-complexity relation is numerically nontrivial, but rho0 is assumed, the compact loop does not yield 1/3 canonically, and no prospective preregistration exists.

claims.claim: Higgs lambda and absolute mass bridge
claims.reason: Lambda_H is introduced by a chosen averaging formula, while v and M_H inherit tau and S_vac. The independent G_F zero-matching test fails by 0.184 percent.
The reciprocal Gram norm follows from the selected integral normalization, but the physical Dirac vertex using it is not derived from the unified action.

claims.claim: one real Majorana core zero line
claims.reason: Core gluing is consistent once the square-root-torsion defect is declared, but the defect is additional structure not forced by the parent S2T action.
The norm is exact in the canonical affine configuration metric, but generic spectral kernels split the weights and the same parent metric fails the tau sector.
The absolute Dirac insertion and unified action are open, so agreement of the splittings has low evidential weight.
G_F, sin^2 theta_W, alpha_s, M_W and M_Z fail the frozen scorecard; correct-sign running and the minimal finite-threshold cone do not repair them.

global_verdict.current_version_IIA: Reject as a closed unified predictive physical theory: it has zero surviving closed independent empirical predictions under the frozen evidence rule.
global_verdict.minimal_realization: Falsified/closed negatively in its gauge sector and unified-normalization gate.
global_verdict.broader_ontology: Not falsified because it is not a unique quantitative theory; it remains a geometric-philosophical research hypothesis.
global_verdict.mathematical_value: Nonempty: carrier bookkeeping, reproduced lens-space spectra, Gram identities, conditional defect theorems and several no-go results remain valid mathematics.
global_verdict.stop_rule: Do not pursue further phenomenological numerology. Reopen physical status only after a preregistered parent action yields two independent observables.
